messages:
Liam: Heads-up  SparrowEdge asked for a joint power vs throughput validation next week. They want steady-state perf-per-watt for the marketplace entry. Can we scope tests?
Anna: Sounds good. Which models + configs?
SparrowOps: SparrowEdge here  target models: tiny-llm (8k ctx) and chat-4k. Hardware: SparrowA1 (8x accelerators). We can stream board power and thermal sensors. Lab window Wed-Thu.
Josh: Proposed test matrices: A) concurrency sweep (1,2,4,8) for 10k requests each; B) 30-minute sustained runs at 50/75/100% load to capture thermal drift. Same seed + corpus for deterministic input.
Sophia: Will use `redwood-infer-run` harness with pinned model sha. Example: ```bash
redwood-infer-run --model tiny-llm@sha256:abcd1234 --hardware sparrow-a1 --concurrency 4 --seq-len 2048 --duration 1800 --collect nvml,power,thermal
```
Sophia: CSV schema: `ts,wall_ms,reqs,done,qps,lat_p50,lat_p95,lat_p99,power_w,board_c,case_c,mem_mb`
Liam: Request Sparrow team expose power.watts and board_temp at 5s resolution so steady-state window detection is accurate.
SparrowOps: We can do 5s. HBM traces are not shareable, but aggregate counters ok. We'll attach lab safety cert.
Josh: Define steady-state as a 10-minute window with <3% qps variance. We'll compute avg_power, avg_qps, and perf_per_watt = avg_qps / avg_power. Include p95 and p99 latency.
Anna: Who's owner for the marketplace badge thresholds? PM wants three tiers. I can propose numbers but need real-world baselines.
Sophia: I'll run a staging dry-run today and push artifacts to `gs://redwood-partners/sparrowedge/1738254321-dryrun/`.
bench-bot: dry-run finished  artifacts: `throughput.csv` (3.8k rows), `nvml.tsv`, `runtime.log`. No OOMs or throttling in 30m.
Josh: @SparrowOps please confirm Wed 09:00-16:00 PT and on-call contact for hardware alarms. We'll want someone to acknowledge AVR/thermal alerts.
SparrowOps: Confirmed Wed 09:00-16:00 PT. On-call: @maria.ops. Rigs will be staged by 08:30.
Liam: Next steps: 1) Sophia validates harness (today) 2) Anna drafts badge thresholds + short blurb (tomorrow) 3) Joint run Wed morning  produce one-pager with graphs and perf-per-watt table.
Anna: I'll start the one-pager template and include a quick FAQ on methodology and IP boundaries.
Sophia: After the run let's do a 30m postmortem to pick which run to publish and to sanity-check numbers.
Liam: Great. Post blockers here. :thumbsup:
